components.css: .ds-key{font-family:Manrope,-apple-system,sans-serif;position:relative;width:216px;height:218px;border:0;border-radius:39px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fcfbf5,#e1e1d6);color:#4c5142;font-size:48px;cursor:pointer;transform:rotate(-13deg) rotateX(20deg) rotateY(-14deg);box-shadow:4px 12px 0 #c8c9ba,6px 15px 0 #b8baab,13px 30px 30px #454b3426,inset 0 2px 2px #fff;transition:transform 500ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-key:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:12px;border:1px solid #d4d6c8;border-radius:29px}.ds-key:hover,.ds-key:focus-visible{transform:translateY(5px) rotate(-9deg) rotateX(12deg) rotateY(-9deg)}.ds-key:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #c74c16;outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-key{transition:none;transform:none}.ds-key:hover,.ds-key:focus-visible{transform:none}}

narrative.overview: A spacious, persuasive landing page introduces local dictation with a tactile Fn instrument, a graphite demonstration chapter, and real app captures. Scoped to website/; desktop design documents remain separate.
keyCharacteristics: Authentic screenshots and truthful early access requirements

rules.name: Evidence before claims
rules.body: Use real app captures and explicitly simulated demonstration text. Keep setup and release constraints visible.

rules.name: Selective depth
rules.body: Reserve dimensional shadows for the Fn instrument, floating detail, screenshots, and modal.

dos: Do preserve visible focus, skip navigation, native modal behavior, and gallery keyboard controls.
Do show completed sample text after transcription and provide cancellation.
Do disclose Apple Silicon, macOS 26+, English, setup model download, and lack of Apple notarization.
donts: Do not imply microphone capture in the browser demo.
Do not claim guaranteed speed, accuracy, or public source availability.
Do not apply the marketing palette to the desktop app.
